mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title, v.category_id, c.name as category_name, v.member_id, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.challenger_id, ch.nickname as challenger_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at, COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0) AS likes_count, COALESCE(co.comments_count, 0) AS comments_count FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id LEFT JOIN member ch ON ch.id = v.challenger_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS likes_count FROM likes GROUP BY vote_id ) l ON l.vote_id = v.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS comments_count FROM comment GROUP BY vote_id ) co ON co.vote_id = v.id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.category_id, c.name as category_name, v.member_id, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.content, v.challenger_id, ch.nickname as challenger_nickname, v.challenger_content, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at, COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0) AS likes_count, COALESCE(co.comments_count, 0) AS comments_count, COALESCE(vt.home_count, 0) AS home_count, COALESCE(vt.away_count, 0) AS away_count, COALESCE(vt.neutral_count, 0) AS neutral_count FROM vote v JOIN category c ON v.category_id = c.id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id LEFT JOIN member ch ON ch.id = v.challenger_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS likes_count FROM likes GROUP BY vote_id ) l ON l.vote_id = v.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS comments_count FROM comment GROUP BY vote_id ) co ON co.vote_id = v.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vote_id, SUM(content = 'home') AS home_count, SUM(content = 'away') AS away_count, SUM(content = 'neutral') AS neutral_count FROM voter GROUP BY vote_id ) vt ON vt.vote_id = v.id
WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT v.id, v.title, v.category_id, c.name as category_name, v.member_id, m.nickname as member_nickname, v.challenger_id, ch.nickname as challenger_nickname, v.created_at, v.updated_at, v.duration, v.ended_at, COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0) AS likes_count, COALESCE(co.comments_count, 0) AS comments_count FROM vote v JOIN category c ON c.id = v.category_id JOIN member m ON m.id = v.member_id LEFT JOIN member ch ON ch.id = v.challenger_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS likes_count FROM likes GROUP BY vote_id ) l ON l.vote_id = v.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vote_id, COUNT(*) AS comments_count FROM comment GROUP BY vote_id ) co ON co.vote_id = v.id
v.deleted_at IS NULL
AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND v.category_id = #{categoryId}
